title: Motivator

sources.title: Save the Gondians
markers: | description = Save the Gondians is a quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Zanner Toobin in the Steel Watch Foundry.

summary: Used or dropped, Prinski’s Motivator can kill nearby Gondians wearing linked collars.

fields.Disarm: Pass a DC 5 Intelligence check before activation. A failed check causes a small-radius explosion. Directing follower Zanner Toobin to disable it spends his Action without deactivating it.
fields.Acquisition: Pickpocket certain Black Gauntlets in the Steel Watch Foundry. Passing the relevant Deception check can make Tamia Holzt hand it over.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
